result.instructions: This is an isolated conformance adapter. Only doctor{} and interaction describe are forwarded to the actual candidate. host_probe is test-only and never accesses a device. Retained images are historical, not fresh captures.

tools.name: pico_doctor
tools.description: DOOR 9 — Health-check the local PICO environment: the read-only preflight (node/adb/emulator/gRPC/Accessibility/calibration/disk — every failure carries the exact fix), toolchain payloads, emulator state, and the v20 camera calibration. Run this FIRST on a new machine, and whenever anything smells off. Pass {calibrate:true} to also RUN the one-time camera calibration end-to-end (fleet_build(['calib']) → calibrate_capture_camera): the inner child server already runs the FULL surface, so no surface switch or client restart is needed — it does need a running emulator and takes a few minutes.

calibrate.description: Build+launch the calib brief and solve the capture camera through the full-surface inner server. Requires a running emulator; takes minutes.

tools.name: pico_interaction
tools.description: Opt-in bounded semantic fixture session: describe/build/open/observe/act/scenario/iterate/watch/stop. Explicit emulator, APK and lifecycle binding; app debug action ACKs are not hand/controller input. Obtain actual native ownership separately. Never boots, chooses a headset, clears data, or owns CLI WorkflowRun lifecycle. Frames require LOOK. stop releases only a drained MCP session; uncertainty remains held.

tools.name: host_probe
tools.description: Test-only read-only host conformance. image delivers a retained historical PNG via the production MCP formatter; error is intentional; wait lasts 30 seconds or ends on MCP cancellation; identity returns this connection generation. No native operations.
